This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Lieutenant Venka (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then). Dates of repository uploads attest those copies; they do not by themselves establish first release.
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="ht-venka-022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/lieutenantvenka.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository). Document: no errata mark. Text: “Deploys -1 to ''Executor''. While aboard a capital starship, adds 1 to armor and its defense value may not be reduced. While Fear Will Keep Them In Line here, when you win a battle at a related site where you have an Imperial, opponent loses 2 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lieutenant Venka (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image first published 10 July 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/hires/lieutenantvenka.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4 commit 44c7bc5], “Hi Res Sets 8 and 9”); card-size image uploaded the same day<ref name="ht-venka-6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/lieutenantvenka.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: errata mark “E1”. '''What changed:''' “While Fear Will Keep Them In Line here, when you win a battle at a related site where you have an Imperial, opponent loses 2 Force.” became “If Fear Will Keep Them In Line here and your Imperial just won a battle at a related site, opponent loses 2 Force.”; the errata mark “E1” now prints. Text: “Deploys -1 to ''Executor''. While aboard a capital starship, adds 1 to armor and its defense value may not be reduced. If Fear Will Keep Them In Line here and your Imperial just won a battle at a related site, opponent loses 2 Force.”
